description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity:  
  
We are seeking a Platform Engineer to design, build, and scale our next-generation intelligent systems as part of our DevSecOps team. You will be part of a team responsible for implementing enterprise-grade processing systems, and ensuring the secure deployment of processing workloads in systems deployed worldwide. The ideal candidate is a self-motivated technical leader who thrives in agile environments and adapts quickly to emerging technologies.   
  
 Responsibilities:  
   
 Design, implement, and support services using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or similar technologies.   
 Build, optimize, and maintain production-grade CI/CD pipelines   
 Design and manage data preprocessing workflows, chunking strategies, and vector database infrastructure.   
 Build and maintain automation using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, Logic Apps, and Azure Functions.   
 Configure and tune network security groups (NSGs), application gateways, and other protective cloud controls.   
 Manage compute, storage, networking, and database services across cloud environments while ensuring adherence to security and compliance frameworks.   
 Collaborate closely with developers and subject matter experts to integrate testing into pipelines.   
 Establish and enforce security best practices for system implementations and data privacy.   
 O&M of existing Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes environments across multiple security domains in Cloud, data center, and edge environments   
 Conduct trade studies to select appropriate open-source, commercial or existing government solutions/technologies to balance performance, cost, user experience and time to operations   
 Work with internal and external teams to understand integration requirements and scale existing platforms to meet them   
 Work with Security to ensure ongoing compliance and develop secure solutions   
  
  
  
 Qualifications:  
   
 Required:    
 U.S. Citizenship required     
 TS/SCI with polygraph   
 BS/BA + 10 years or equivalency (AA + 15 years of experience, MS + 8 Years of experience or no degree + 20 years of experience)      
 10+ years of experience in cloud/infrastructure engineering   
 Extensive hands-on engineering experience in one or more of Azure, AWS, GCP   
 Expert Terraform skills; proven experience managing infrastructure with infrastructure as code   
 Experience operating production Kubernetes clusters (AKS/EKS) supporting processing workloads   
 Experience with containers (Docker, Podman) and CI/CD   
 Python scripting/programming abilities   
 Experience with Java & Python build toolchains 
  
   
 Desired:   
 Previous intelligence community experience   
 Experience with CSAM, RegScale, eMASS, or similar GRC tools   
 Experience supporting emergency operations or disaster response missions   
 Experience with continuous monitoring and automated security tools   
 Strong communication skills for presenting to senior leadership   
   
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$93,500 - $196,500 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
